messages:
Noor (AE): HalcyonCare is greenlighting a 7-day POC next month. They sent back the security questionnaire with a few must-haves: encrypted SAML assertions, SCIM bulk + delta behavior, automated multi-domain TXT verification, RBAC mapping from IdP groups, and pricing for Dedicated vs hosted during SSO peaks. Can SE/Infra/Sec flag anything blocking?
Ethan (SE): Quick read: nothing blocking for POC. SCIM plan: CSV bulk import for ~20k users then ~1k/day deltas. We support SCIM v2 PATCH for membership updates. Need sample CSV and a list of group names they'll use.
Pri (Infra): Private VPC for a POC is doable but takes ~8-10 business days. Hosted with region pin + CMK is much faster (48-72h). Which do they prefer?
Noor (AE): They prefer hosted for speed but want CMK + proof of US-only residency. Also asking if short Dedicated trial is possible for pricing evaluation.
Marta (Security): SAML encryption: we support full assertion + NameID + attributes encryption. We accept SP metadata with encryption certs. Confirm they want RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM or other algos?
Noor (AE): They requested RSA-OAEP + AES-256-GCM in questionnaire.
Ethan (SE): That's fine. For multi-domain SPs, we can ingest multiple metadata entries or support a multi-entity config. For RBAC: pattern = SCIM groups -> Redwood roles; SAML attribute claims -> session-scoped elevation. Provide mapping examples in the FAQ.
Rina (PM): Domain verification automation is not product-ready for many domains yet. For the POC we can do manual TXT verification per domain (security-approved). If they need automation at scale we'll propose roadmap work.
Marta (Security): For healthcare, CMK required. Hosted supports customer-managed KMS; we'll need their KMS ARN + cross-account role. Also ask about key rotation policy.
Liam (Legal): They want SOC2 + DPA and a clause stating customer is responsible for adding TXT records for domain verification. I'll draft standard language. Any other legal asks?
Pri (Infra): For traffic: estimate SAML auth handshakes ~12 qps peak, CSV ingest sustained ~100 qps for import window, SCIM delta bursts ~40 qps. Hosted with a short burst window should handle this; Dedicated makes sense only if sustained >200 qps or strict hardware isolation needed.
Noor (AE): They also worry about immediate session revoke on deprovision.
Marta (Security): We support session invalidation webhook and token blacklist. Hosted propagation best-effort ~<60s. Recommend short access token TTL + immediate revoke on SCIM DELETE. Document this in FAQ.
Ethan (SE): One nuance: SCIM ordering guarantees are best-effort. If they need strong ordering we can add idempotency/sequence keys; will require small client changes.
Rina (PM): Ops tasks for POC: 1) enable temporary SCIM rate bump window, 2) ingest multiple SP metadata entries, 3) enable session revoke webhook. ETA 24-48h after we receive SP metadata, sample CSV, domains list, and KMS ARN.
Noor (AE): Good. Can SE/Sec/Infra produce a one-pager for their tech team and a short checklist for Legal?
Ethan (SE): I'll post a 1-page FAQ with mapping examples, SCIM limits, bulk-import steps, and required artifacts by EOD.
Marta (Security): I'll add the recommended security answers and artifact checklist (SP metadata, cert, sample CSV, KMS ARN, desired TTLs).
Pri (Infra): I'll post provisioning timelines and the hosted vs private decision matrix.
infra-bot: Scheduled action: "poc-scim-boost" will run in staging in 3h to support a test import window. Reply "cancel" to abort.
Liam (Legal): I'll draft DPA + domain responsibility clause and post it here for review.
Noor (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll collect artifacts from HalcyonCare and share. If they push Dedicated, we will bring Sales Ops and Infra into a separate thread.
